parole.testo: Related to Medieval Latin castō, from Proto-West Germanic *kastō (“box, case”).

parole.significato: stork (large bird with long neck and legs and a long straight beak; fam. Ciconiidae)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Middle High German stork or from Middle Dutch stork, from Old High German storh or Old Dutch *stork, both from Proto-West Germanic *stork (compare German Storch, English stork).
